svg.title: Recall vs. False-positive Rate
svg.desc: TurnBench Interruption, October 15, 2026. Sixteen of 23 models with Recall at least 80% and FPR at most 15%. Recall increases upward and FPR decreases to the right. Point area represents median detection latency. AI Rudder Helm Swift and Helm Bearing are highlighted in blue. All points retain their benchmark coordinates.

svg.aria-label: Sixteen TurnBench interruption models with Recall at least 80 percent and FPR at most 15 percent. Recall increases upward, FPR decreases to the right. Circle area represents median detection latency. All points use their true benchmark coordinates.
svg.text: False-positive rate (%) · Lower to the right →
